name: RPG: Character Paths
author: Jeffiest
description: A real character build. Kills give XP, levels give HP, damage, toughness and skill points. Toan spends them on three paths (Swordsman, Survivor, Explorer) in the Journal's Character page: crits, Riposte, Sword Dance, Second Wind, Battle Cry, weapon study, thirst and durability savings, Atla sense, treasure and XP bonuses. Weapon mastery, loot rolls and the DarkCloud-Expanded weapon abilities stay. Other characters level up and get their own paths later.

settings.name: Weapons you pick up can roll bonus stats
